name: My Own Little Corner
thesis: Raygen’s purple cat portrait anchors a playful blackberry-purple home with buoyant personal lettering and real machines waiting just below.
interaction: Turn the oversized portrait to read a short introduction, then explore the printers and remove SERV0’s panels with an accessible toggle.
why: The opening belongs to a specific person: their actual avatar, an expressive name, warm asides, and a natural path from personal identity to making things and Hack Club.
